title: Golden Crown interface
summary: Menus and the HUD now wear the Crown's aged oxblood, ivory and brass look, and fit phones, tablets and wide screens.
notes: Restyle menus, buttons and panels in a 1960s Art Deco casino style with a teal highlight for the selected option.
Turn the pause menu into a Golden Crown hotel directory with Resume, Inventory, Settings, Activities, Players, Account and Quit.
Hide the whole HUD and touch controls while the pause menu is open.
Add a Players page listing everyone in the session alongside the leaderboard and player stats.
Show the held weapon, its ammo and slots 1-9 in one weapon panel; tap or click a slot to equip it.
Keep weapon slots large and swipeable on phones and narrow screens instead of shrinking them.
Show money as a small coin chip in the top-left corner, a compact HP bar on its own, and voice activity with nearby players in the top-right corner.
Greet guests at the bar with a portrait conversation panel offering Buy, Ask and Leave.
